name: progress-tracker
description: Personal, minimalist life-tracking app — alpha infrastructure pass.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.format: npm run format:repo && npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:repo && npm run format:check --prefix frontend && npm run format:check --prefix backend
